children: MULTI BUSINESS GROUP COMPANY FOR PROJECTS
UPDATES ON FIRE INCIDENT AT RIYADH PROJECT BUILDING
DAMAGE WAS LIMITED TO PART OF BUILDING WHERE INCIDENT OCCURRED, WHILE WORKS CONTINUE ON REMAINING BUILDINGS OF PROJECT
ESTIMATES PRELIMINARY COST OF WORKS AFFECTED BY INCIDENT AT ALMOST SAR 3.2 MILLION
COST OF AFFECTED WORKS IS EXPECTED TO AFFECT CO'S NET PROFIT DURING Q4 OF 2026
SUBMITTED A CLAIM TO INSURANCE COMPANY UNDER CONTRACTORS' ALL RISKS INSURANCE POLICY
